game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time

author: Idkwn
quote:
Idk what hooked me up so bad on this game, if its the world, the story, i dont really know, but i didn’t have this much fun in a while now. This game can’t even be compared with other from the series, and also just set up a new standard for the open-world games. The haters gonna hate it how much they like, but it is really one of the greatest, if not the greatest game of all time. The world is so immersive that you get lost in it, waking up 2-3 hours later that you still didn’t got to the mission you wanted to do. The story feels great, i think that the last mission from the chapter 1 was one of the greatest finale **** chapter ever. I am currently in chapter 3, and this game grows bigger and bigger on me. The only minus is that it is locked to 30 frames, but if you have a good enough monitor/tv and activate some things in the display settings, it is just incredible. The amount of diversity in random events, in npcs, in interactions, it is just CRAZY. The only game that will surpass this will probably be one from the same developers lol. These guys never miss.

Also, i can compare this game with a lot of newer games that i played, like RE Requiem/Crimson Desert/PB0, even Cyberpunk can be in this list if you would like. I think every one of the above have something special in their category of games, but GTA 6 is the only one here who deserves to be claimed as the best. It is the only one who brings something new on the table. For the Cyberpunk fans that still claim that cyberpunk has the most exciting open-world, wake up.


Bringing it back to the 30 frames per second, i think console players never experienced this kind of graphics and this kind of level of details ever. I think Rockstar just genuine uses some kind of magic to make it work in 30 fps on these 2020 consoles. 

In almost 19 hours of gameplay i only experienced 2 or 3 bugs, which i find in normal in a new released game, idk what other people say about one million bugs or whatever. 

I am 100% sure that no other games in 10 years from now will surpass or even be on the same level with this one.

I am not talking so much about the story because i didn’t finished it yet, but so far its really nicely done.
